verdict.rationale: Paddle is a payments platform, so PCI scope reduction through tokenization is an applicable axis. However, the evidence pack never mentions PCI DSS, tokenization, or card data staying off the merchant's servers. The overlay and inline checkout docs describe Paddle.js handling the checkout UI but say nothing about how card data is isolated, so they cannot be credited as evidence for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers
